verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents transactional messages as their own message type. They are sent through a dedicated transactional API (App API), separate from broadcasts and automations, and are aimed at receipts, password resets and shipping updates. That is a first-party separation of transactional sending, but the evidence does not show how far that separation goes. missing for 10: dedicated transactional templates, separate suppression/unsubscribe handling that lets receipts reach unsubscribed contacts, separate sending reputation or IP/domain isolation, independent corroboration.
